qualification_scope: Independent open-source Community HACS TEST of one native HA 2026.11.2 integration, full extracted tagged source package and bundled five-tab panel. Guided standalone setup and explicit physical commissioning; self-owned ChargeController, Charger and ChargeableAsset HA entities automatically registered, without user-created helpers or any RHI Basic/Premium runtime. Dashboard/native-device operational settings, editable 80% starting car target, daily Ready By repeat, Controller site limits and tariff/solar/SoC source selection, Charger min/max/set kW guarded by hardware limits, source-qualified cable observations, recorded planning and existing guarded single-writer physical executor. Exact-main PR/source checks, Hassfest, packaged artifact SHA256/provenance, actual installed Home Assistant setup/Options/source, restart/upgrade/rollback applicability and native device registration.
limitations: Explicit incremental TEST only; not STABLE, complete product UC/FLEX/FORECAST or field-accepted hardware. For real charging, the installer must commission exactly one physical writer, independent native connection/power/current readbacks, safe electrical/circuit/phase bounds, and confirm the actually connected vehicle; unqualified or unconnected controls remain unavailable. Hardware-variable kW is unavailable on fixed on/off chargers and when capability sources are absent. Actual EVSE live START/STOP/modulation, field cable truth, Safari/iPad/resident UX, full 29 UCs, external provider mappings, all device/tariff combinations and installed user migration/rollback require separate field qualification. No Wessels site/Core/Basic/Premium package is bundled or required. Existing v0.1.5 remains immutable rollback.
